title: provision remote mirror service framework and nginx reverse proxy for aios.w33d.xyz

criteria: Provisioner creates /srv/aios-mirror static metadata layout on the remote host.
Nginx serves aios.w33d.xyz health, mirror descriptor, channel index, and release placeholder.
Hosted channel metadata is hash-bound to RC4 final audit, hosted transport manifest, and mirror publication.
Evidence records metadata-only storage, no signing authority, no activation authority, and no GA claim.
